test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some parks are hospitals.

Some hospitals are schools.

Some schools are colleges.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parks are colleges.

II. All hospitals are schools.

III. No park is a college

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Either conclusion I or III follows.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution: The least possible Venn diagram is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aab22e4a68f99f3b0bd736f00b9d47967874054c4e56f44d603abcfa5a23c9db.png] Conclusions: I. Some parks are colleges. → Does not follow (As, there is no definite relation between parks and colleges. Hence, false)
